# Features by Minecraft version

A project may target any Minecraft version from 1.21.11 on (`minecraft` in `netherforge.json`). What NetherForge does that an older version can't is listed here with the version it needs: a file that uses it in a project for an older version is the problem [`project.feature`](problems.md#project-feature), and a script that does gets an error.

| Feature | Needs Minecraft | What it is |
| - | - | - |
| `sky-night` | 26.1 | A sky that doesn't darken at night |
